description:
Review uncommitted changes in the vault, then stage and commit them with git.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it

Flags:
  review:
    --max-file-lines N  max diff lines shown per file; default 150
    --max-lines N       max output lines overall; default 3000
  save:
    --message SUBJECT   required; single line; must not be empty
    --body TEXT         commit body; may span multiple lines
    --dry-run           report what would be staged and committed; change nothing

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Northwind: log scope workshop and payment", "--body", "Added meeting note, 90 min hours entry, one payment."]
  ["save", "--message", "Flush buffer", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run `review` first, then `save` with a summary based on what review showed.
  `save` only ever adds a commit. It never amends, rebases, resets or pushes.
  Exit 1 means one of: an empty or multi-line --message, the vault is not a git repository or not the root of its repository, or a git command failed.
